messages:
Maya: Hey team — quick design review request for the Playground streaming UI tweaks. Pasted screenshots in thread. Main asks: (1) streaming indicator placement, (2) stop vs pause vs regenerate affordances, (3) token counter visibility, (4) prompt library quick insert behavior. Trying to keep a11y and copy minimal.

Aisha: Thanks — looked through. First pass: streaming indicator feels noisy on the left rail, suggests moving to top-right of the chat bubble (overlay) so it doesn't compete with the prompt rail. Also +1 to a persistent small token count in the composer not on the message.

Sam: Technical note: if we overlay on the bubble we need to ensure it doesn't reflow messages when it appears. We can absolutely position with transform: translate and use aria-live for stream updates. Example CSS:
```css
.stream-badge { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; transform: translateZ(0); }
```
This keeps layout stable.

Diego: UX trade: overlay is less discoverable on compact mode. Maybe show overlay on desktop, and a top-of-pane banner on mobile. Also want to avoid two different stop buttons. Can we surface a single primary control and a secondary action in the overflow?

Aisha: Agreed on single primary. My mock: primary is a rounded "Stop" pill at right edge of composer while streaming, with a subtle icon and label. Secondary (Regenerate) appears after stream ends as primary action. Copy options: "Stop" vs "Pause" — I prefer "Stop" because Pause implies resume which we don't support for partial results.

Liam: Accessibility nit: "Stop" must have clear ARIA label like `aria-label="Stop streaming response"`. Also ensure focus order — when stream starts, focus must remain in composer (don't steal focus). For token counter, provide a text alternative: "Tokens used: 1,234" that screen readers can read on demand.

Sam: For token counter placement: cheaper to render near the composer right side with lower opacity. We already track tokens in the backend; exposing it in the composer is just reading value. Performance-wise fine. One ask: show rolling per-response token delta only when you expand details.

Aisha: Copy tweak suggestions for small token label: "~1.2k tokens" (visually) and SR-only: "approx 1,200 tokens used for last response". For the streaming indicator microcopy: use "Streaming…" with ellipsis and `role=status`.

Diego: Prompt library quick-insert: current behavior inserts full prompt into composer which can be huge. Suggest inserting collapsed prompt snippet with a pill that expands inline when clicked — avoids pushing user far down in long chats. Also add a tiny confirmation toast: "Prompt added to composer" with undo.

Maya: Love the collapsed snippet idea. Any objections?

Sam: Works for us. Implementation: insert a short HTML node: `<button class=prompt-snippet>` that when activated fetches full template from prompt service. Prevents large DOM bloat. We should also debounce consecutive inserts.

Liam: Accessibility for snippet: ensure keyboard-expandable and announce expansion via `aria-expanded`. The toast must be accessible too.

Aisha: Visual microcopy for toast: "Added prompt — press Esc to undo" (Esc UX still TBD). Or show small undo link in the toast. Keep short.

Maya: One other micro: regenerate after stream ends — label should be "Regenerate response" (explicit) and the icon should be the circular arrow. Avoid ambiguous "Retry".

Sam: Edge case: if user clicks regenerate while a background request is queued, we should cancel the existing KV cache write, then spawn new request. I'll add a backend flag.

Design-bot: Mock updated: https://figma.com/file/xyz/playground-streaming-v3 — comments open.

Diego: Ok next steps: Aisha to push updated mock with overlay vs banner variations, Sam to prototype CSS & event handling, Liam to write the a11y checklist, Maya to consolidate copy. Delivery target EOW.

Maya: Thanks all — will follow up with a short PRD and link to figma. :sparkles:
